$comment: Third-party apps this runtime is tested against. CI reads this file (job `apps-list` in .github/workflows/ci.yml) and runs each entry's `entry` script on the listed systems. See integrations/README.md for the convention. Keys: name (also the directory under integrations/), repo + ref (pinned commit), systems, entry, timeout-minutes, stages (what the entry script asserts).

apps.name: readest
stages: their Rust suite (cargo test -p Readest --lib) passes on a build that links this runtime
the app boots on this runtime and its own invoke() round-trips to Rust (CDP check)
apps.notes: Heavy: needs pnpm, network, several GB and a long Rust build. WebDriver-driven suites cannot run (QtWebEngine has no Target.createTarget) — see the app README.
